title: You Frame It: How Conceptual Representations Shape LLM Detection and Reasoning about Antisemitism

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of large language models in detecting and classifying various forms of antisemitic content (e.g., aggressive hate, classic tropes, Israel-related, and post-Holocaust) using expert-annotated datasets and different conceptual prompting frameworks (such as the IHRA definition and fine-grained taxonomies).
